map.本工具依据气道护理规范给出年龄别吸痰负压安全范围，供参数设定参考，以设备调节与医: This tool gives age-based suction-pressure safe ranges per airway-care standards for parameter setting; defer to device adjustment and orders.
map.按年龄取推荐负压区间：成人 80–120 mmHg、儿童 80–100 mmHg: Age-based recommended ranges: adult 80-120 mmHg, child 80-100 mmHg, infant 60-80 mmHg, newborn 40-60 mmHg. Below the lower limit means inadequate suction; above the upper limit means airway mucosal injury risk; within the range means safe. Based on the AARC 2010 clinical practice guideline on endotracheal suctioning and the ERC 2021 resuscitation guidelines; actual pressure must be individualized for age, secretion characteristics, artificial-airway type and device calibration, and follow medical orders.
map.成人吸痰负压推荐范围：80-120 mmHg (10.6-16.0 kPa): Adult recommended suction range: 80-120 mmHg (10.6-16.0 kPa)
map.儿童吸痰负压推荐范围：80-100 mmHg (10.6-13.3 kPa): Child recommended suction range: 80-100 mmHg (10.6-13.3 kPa)
map.婴幼儿吸痰负压推荐范围：60-80 mmHg (8.0-10.6 kPa): Infant recommended suction range: 60-80 mmHg (8.0-10.6 kPa)
map.新生儿吸痰负压推荐范围：40-60 mmHg (5.3-8.0 kPa): Newborn recommended suction range: 40-60 mmHg (5.3-8.0 kPa)
map.当前压力 150 mmHg（≈20.0 kPa）过高（超过安全上限 120 mm: Current pressure 150 mmHg (~20.0 kPa) is too high (above the 120 mmHg upper limit); risk of mucosal injury!
map.依据 AARC 2010《气管内吸痰临床实践指南》与 ERC 2021 复苏指南: Based on the AARC 2010 clinical practice guideline on endotracheal suctioning and the ERC 2021 resuscitation guidelines: adult pressure should be 80-120 mmHg; above 120 mmHg is too high and below 80 mmHg is too low; children and infants use lower age-specific ranges. Actual pressure must be individualized for age, secretion characteristics, artificial-airway type, device calibration and medical orders; do not apply the ranges mechanically.
map.两次吸引间隔不少于1分钟，避免低氧血症: >=1 min between passes to avoid hypoxemia
map.吸引管外径不超过气管插管内径的1/2: Catheter OD no more than half the tube inner diameter
map.边旋转边退管，不可在进管时吸引: Rotate while withdrawing; never suction on insertion
map.警告：成人负压超过 120 mmHg 可导致气道黏膜损伤、出血、低氧血症；低于: Warning: adult pressure above 120 mmHg can cause airway mucosal injury, bleeding and hypoxemia; below 80 mmHg suction is inadequate. Children, infants and newborns need lower age-specific ranges; choose pressure according to the patient's condition and medical orders.
